# `{ }` — Dfn / Dop

`{…}` defines a function of `α` and `ω`, or an operator when it uses `⍶` or `⍹`. `;` separates its bodies. When a [predicate](question.qmd) `C?` is false, evaluation moves on to the next body. The last statement gives the result. See [Dfns](../dfns.ipynb).

```bpl
{ω×2}3             ⍝ 6
2{α+ω}3            ⍝ 5
{ω<0?-ω;ω}¯3       ⍝ 3
```
